en.Note: Note: If the push results conflict with your local results, please manually change or reset them.
en.guideStep1: Mode — five radio buttons, only one at a time. Standard is the default and outputs the complete block; every other option outputs only the lines it needs.
en.guideStep2: Match info — set BanNums (4 or 5), tick Game in Progress to leave length and winner blank, and tick Without Space to ignore every space when matching heroes.
en.guideStep3: Side and winner — click Team1Side to toggle blue/red; Team2 takes the opposite side automatically, click Winner to toggle Team1/Team2, and click Change Side to swap the two teams' input blocks (Team1Side turns red).
en.guideStep4: Length — MM and SS accept digits only and are padded on blur; leaving them empty produces 00:00.
en.guideStep5: Heroes — type a full name or an alias and pick from the list. A red border means no match, a yellow border means several matches, and a hero filled into more than one box is highlighted.
en.guideStep6: Keyboard — Tab and Shift+Tab move between inputs and buttons; ↑ / ↓ move through the suggestion list; Enter confirms the highlighted entry; Esc closes the list.
en.guideStep7: Alias management — edit aliases, add or delete heroes via “Search/Update Hero Alias or Add Hero”. Changes stay in this browser and merge with updated data.json automatically; use Clear LocalStorage to reset.

zh.Note: Note: 如果推送结果与您的本地化结果冲突，请手动更改或者重置。
zh.guideStep1: 模式 —— 五个单选项，同时只能选一个；默认“标准模式”输出完整内容，其余选项只输出各自需要的内容。
zh.guideStep2: 比赛信息 —— 设置 BanNums（4 或 5）；勾选“比赛进行中”会把时长和胜方留空；勾选“无需空格”后，匹配英雄时输入内容与候选内容都会先去掉空格。
zh.guideStep3: 选边与胜方 —— 点击 Team1Side 在蓝/红之间切换，队伍2 自动取相反颜色；点击 Winner 在队伍1/队伍2 之间切换；点击“换边”交换两队的输入区（此时 Team1Side 变为红色）。
zh.guideStep4: 时长 —— MM 与 SS 只接受数字，失焦后自动补零；留空按 00:00 输出。
zh.guideStep5: 英雄 —— 输入完整名称或别名后从下拉列表选择。红框表示未匹配，黄框表示匹配到多个；同一英雄填入多个输入框时会被标出。
zh.guideStep6: 键盘操作 —— Tab / Shift+Tab 在输入框与按钮之间切换；↑ / ↓ 在候选列表中移动；回车键确认所选条目；Esc 关闭列表。
zh.guideStep7: 别名管理 —— 通过“搜索/更新英雄别名或添加英雄”修改别名、新增或删除英雄。改动保存在本浏览器，并会与更新后的 data.json 自动合并；需要彻底重置时使用 Clear LocalStorage。
